context: Initial KMSAN archive upload while KASAN/NVIDIA Plasma X11 3D was active
consequence: Invalid extraction left old KASAN DRM modules alongside the KMSAN kernel; module loading failed. This attempt is excluded from coverage.
mitigation: Verify archive SHA256 before extraction and verify all installed module hashes before reboot; verify builder downloads too.
followup: 12 checksum-verified transfers of the same archive under NVIDIA Plasma X11 3D load: six KMSAN and six KASAN, all matched.
